tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje nag po chen po tsa turmu kha'i dam tshig bskangs chog sngon 'gro bsham yig zur bskol bzhugs so// na mo gu ru tsa turmu kha ye/ rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa'i man ngag dam tshig bskang gso'i sngon 'gro bsham gyi yi ge logs su bkod pa ni gnas khang chag chag dang / phyi dor legs par byas/ bla ma yi dam chos skyong srung ma'i rten bris 'bur gang rigs gnas khang gi babs dang bstun nas bzhugs su gsol pa'i drung du spyan gzig rnams mdzes par bkram pa'i byang ngos su stegs bang rim bzhi pa rten khebs sogs kyis bkab la 'bru sna tshogs bcal du bkram/ bang rim dang po la g.yas su yi dam maṇḍal sgrub mchod kyi tshom bu dang / 'bras dkar gtsang mar phul lnga tsam dang dri bzang mtshon pa/ g.yon du rten rdo tshom bu can gur dang bcas pa bshams/ bang rim gnyis pa la dngul sder sogs snod so sor kyai rdor bde mchog gur lcam dral thun mong / zhal rnams la zlum gtor re re/ gtor gdugs sngon po dur khrod bdag po'i bskang gtor bzhin/ gtor gdugs ser po/ las mkhan dang dkar mo bar zlum gtor gtor gdugs sngon po dang dkar po/ bdud rgyal phur srung gnyis la gru gsum re/ gtor gdugs sngon po dang ljang khu/ phur srung la rma bya'i sgro gsum mam lnga/ gtor gdugs 'dzin pa'i mda' dang lhan cig bcings pa/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang gzhi bdag la thun mong du zlum gtor/ gtor gdugs ljang khu/ de thams cad sdom phye phud rjen nag dmar rgyan/ rgyan mar/ tshon kha dog sna tshogs pa/ gtor rdzas bdud rtsi ril bu sogs byin rlabs yid ches rnams kyi phye ma dang / dkar gsum mngar gsum/ sha gtsang ma sna tshogs/ mar chang chu rnams la sbrus pa/ bang rim gsum par bkram bskang nag po mchod rten rnams snod so so rtse brgyad phyag mtshan sogs kyis mdzes pa g.yas g.yon la ldem mam dung kha ltag sprod gang rigs nag rtsi smug rtsi dmar lcug sgor rgyan gang dgos zab ma bcas so so la mda' dar tshon sna lnga re re/

thams cad kyi phud phyer rjen nag dmar rgyan/ dkar rgyan rnams dang / tshon sna/ gtor rdzas rnams gong ji lta ba bzhin/ bang rim bzhi par chu bzhi sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod/ thun gtor rgyas par na nyin re bzhin brgya dang brgyad/ 'bring po lnga bcu/ bsdus pa nyi shu rtsa lnga/ shin tu bsdu na bdun nam lnga gang rung / gser skyems phud dam bcas/ de'i mdun du sa stegs dpangs su mtho gang / rgyar khru do gru bzhi lhag tsam zhal ba ngos 'jam par byas la/ bdud rtsi ril bu/ gri khrag rang byung gi khrag btsan dug cung zad/ ro sol rnams sbyar ba'i nag por byugs la/ thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab nas/ chu tshon gyi padma 'dab brgyad lte ba nas bzung 'dab ma mu khyud dang bcas pa cha snyoms par dgos pa'i lte ba nag 'dab ma sngo/ shun pa mdzes tshon/ mu khyud ljang khu/ stegs bu'i ngos la me ris sogs ji ltar rigs pa/ de'i steng du 'bru sna tshogs/ mi rus kyi phye ma rnams bkram la dbus su mañdzi mtho ba/ 'dab ma brgyad la mañdzi mtho dma' med pa brgyad dbus las cung zad dma' ba/ de'i khar lcags la sogs pa'i snod ji ltar rigs pa bzang zhing bug rdol med par dbus su che ba dang / mdun gyi 'dab ma gnyis pa nas bdun pa'i bar che chung med pa'i snod du dbus gtor phud phye rab khal gcig 'bring bre bcu/ tha ma bre lnga la gtor rdzas/ sran ma/ bra 'o/ gri sha gri tshil/ mon sran dri'u/ sgog tsong / nya sha la sogs pa'i sha sna gtsang ma/ sbyin bdag gang yin de rang la rjes gnang gi dus su bla mas gnang ba'i me tog nag po/ gtsug lag khang dang mgon khang byin can rnams dang dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi skabs mchod par bshams pa'i me tog nas/ 'bras rnams dri khu med par bkrus pa/ padma rakta gtsang ma yid ches can dngos sam/ yang na sindhu ra/ me tog bya rkang nag po/ gser/ dngul/ byu ru/ mu tig dung / sle tres/ kanḍa ka ri/

dbang lag rgya mtsho lbu ba/ shu dag dkar po/ tsandan dkar dmar/ dza ti/ ga bur/ gur gum/ nas/ 'bras/ gro/ sran ma/ til/ mar/ bu ram/ sbrang rtsi/ tsha/ 'o ma/ bdud rtsi ril bu rnams kyi phye ma bsres la khrag chang mar khu rnams cha snyoms pa'i khu bas sbrus la/ gtor ma gsum gnyis gru gsum dbal can snying gyen du blangs pa lta bu lto ba ldir ba rtse mo phra ba smad sum cha zlum po/ de'i phyogs bzhir gtor ma'i sum gnyis tsam slebs pa'i yum chen gyi gtor ma snying bshos ma'am gru gsum pa gang rigs mtshams bzhir gtor ma'i sum cha tsam slebs pa'i zan gru bzhi'i khar zan gyi thod pa dpral ba gtor mar bstan pa gnyis kyi dbus su zan gyi kong bu'i nang gi tshil 'bri mar dang bsres pa'i bkang la ro ras kyi sdong bu/ g.yas kyi thod par gri khrag gi thigs pa/ g.yon gyi thod par nang mchod kyi thigs pa re blug de'i mtha' bskor du mtheb kyu brgya dang brgyad bcad khams phyir bstan pa/ phyogs bzhi'i gtor ma dang mtshams bzhi'i stegs bu'i dbyibs dang mthun par glo 'bur lta bur brtsigs pa'i khar phyogs mtshams brgyad du mtheb kyu che ba re/ yum bzhi'i gtor mar bre bzhi/ zan steng thod pa brgyad/ mar me bzhi/ mtheb kyu che chung rnams sdom bre gnyis/ dbus kyi gtor ma la rtse sgrom gtor ma'i bong dang mthun par btsugs pa'i ldebs la pad nyi'i khar bum pa mgul chings bcas/ de steng ka li khrag gis gang ba dang / rdo rje gri gug de'i g.yas g.yon du/ rtse gsum/ mdung thung / ral gri/ thod 'phreng / rkang gling rnams cha snyoms nas bkod pa mdzes par brgyan pa'i bar mtshams rnams su rgyal srid sna bdun/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad/ rtags brgyad/ nor bu cha bdun sogs ji ltar rigs pa'i mthar me ris tshon can dmar skya gang rung gser shog sogs spros bcas che ba g.yas g.yon la me ris mdzes pa'i ldem/ gtor ma'i rtse sgor rgyan khra sgor la che ba dkyil gyi ldir sar bzhi rgyan khra sgor ma gshog pa'i sner sgor rgyan re re'i yang na ldem gyi'am/

mchod pa yum chen bzhi'i gtor ma la rtse brgyan chung ngu phyag mtshan gri thod can 'dzugs pa'am/ yang na mig gsum ma sogs ji ltar rigs pa dang / sgor rgyan rgyas bsdus 'tshams pa gtor ma lnga ka'i g.yas su dmar rgyan gtso gtor la gtor gdugs nag po/ yum chen bzhir so so'i sku mdog dang mthun pa'i gtor gdugs/ mtheb kyu rnams ldebs la'ang sgor rgyan che chung dang mang nyung ji ltar rigs pa/ mdun gyi mañdzi'i khar thod pa tshad ldan gtor ma la dpral ba bstan pa'i nang du dug khrag mtha'i gtor ma rnams gtso gtor che chung dang bstun pa'i gtor ma bdun ka'ang gtso bo'i phyed tsam slebs pa che chung ma shor bar byas la gru gsum zur mi rno ba khrag gam smug rtsis byugs pa'i g.yas sdebs la dmar rgyan/ rtse mor sgor rgyan chung ba/ dkyil du sgor rgyan che ba/ thams cad la gtor gdugs nag po mdun gtso gtor la bstan nas g.yas bskor du bshams/ gtor ma 'di bdun sdom rjen phye/ gtso gtor la 'dzugs rgyu'i shog ling mtho gang tsam dang / yum bzhir sor bzhi tsam/ dregs pa sde bdun la sor brgyad tsam mi'i gzugs brnyan rid cing mi sdug pa/ skra gzengs pa/ yan lag lcags sgrog gis bcings pa'i 'di rnams la shog bu bre kha do snying khar ṇi'i mthar/ mdun nas g.yas bskor du yig mgo phyir bstan gyi/ gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes dbu can gyis bris la/ ang btags bkod de gtso gtor la gcig yum chen g.yas par gnyis/ g.yon par gsum/ mdun mar bzhi/ rgyab mar lnga/ pad 'dab gnyis pa'i gtor ma nas bzung bdun pa'i bar la bcu gnyis rnams g.yas skor du bkod la/ ma 'khrul bar byas nas mgo zhabs ldog ste btsugs/ sa stegs kyi khar 'jim pa la bzos pa'i gri snying thod pa tshad ldan gyi nang du mañdzi sogs stegs kyi khar rtse mo gyen dang gser btags mdun du bstan nas bkod/

stobs chen shugs drag gi phyag mtshan rnams kyang bkod pa mdzes par bshams/ mtha' g.yas g.yon la phyi rten rnams gtor ma la kha phyogs pa'am yang na sgrub pa po ngos su bstan la bshams/ mdun du stegs kyi khar thod pa tshad ldan drug gtor ma la dpral ba bstan nas bsgreng tshar du bshams pa'i mgor rgyun 'bab kyi chu gtsang ma la mi khrag khyi khrag sogs khrag gtsang ma sna tshogs dang / dug sna cung zad/ dri bzang rnams btab pa'i mchod yon/ de'i 'og mar thod pa'i nang du dbang po lnga'i me tog so so'i gzugs brnyan dod pa phung por spung pa dang / nas nag bya rkang pa dug gi me tog sna tshogs rnams gsar rnying gang yang rung ba/ de'i 'og mar btsan dug sna 'dres rang byung gi khrag skam rlon gang rung / sgog skya/ yungs dkar/ sran nag rnga mong dang bong bu'i sbang / khrag phal pa/ gu gul/ gri sha/ gri tshil/ gri khrag rta khrag ar skya/ ar nag spos dkar/ tsandan/ ga pur/ gur gum/ me tog bya rkang pa/ gtsug lag khang gi me tog rnams kyis bkang / de'i 'og mar ro ras kyi sdong bu btsugs/ mar nag la mi rta bya ba lang ra khyi phag sogs srog chags du ma'i tshil gyis khu ba zhu ba'i mar me/ de'i 'og mar chu gtsang la srog chags rnams kyi mkhris pa dang / tsandan/ ga bur/ gla rtsi sogs bsil sman sna tshogs sha rul/ khrag rul rnams sbyar ba'i dri chab/ de'i 'og mar gong gi gtor rdzas rnams las grub pa'i drag po'i bshos bu lnga/ snod ji ltar rigs par thun gtor snying gzugs ma lnga/ phud chang bcas/ sha chen/ nas chen/ 'bras chen/ sran 'bru rigs 'di rnams la so so nas bre re re/ chung sha bzhi gling yag pa tshod mar kag do tsam/ chen rnams snod so sor nyin ltar gyi so ma re blugs la/ 'og tu gtor bsngo bdun rdzogs pa'i mthar/ gtso gtor dang / dregs pa sde bdun gyi gtor ma la phul la snod rnams kha sbub/ slob dpon gyi drung du rdor dril/

nang mchod/ ḍā ma ru/ 'thor nas/ bum pa gos zung chu gtsang gis bkang ba la/ tsandan/ gi waṃ/ gur gum/ ga pur/ gla rtsi rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba'i phye ma btab/ ku sha dang sgro mdongs sogs kyis kha brgyan/ ras dar gang rung kha dog dkar po'am sngon po'i mgul chings prog gsum lnga gang rigs kyis brgyan pa rnams bshams/ tshogs kyi yo byad dang gtor kha gso chas rol sil rnga dung rkang gling g.yab dar dung chen sogs ji ltar rigs pa khrus stegs khrus gzhong / me long / sku phyis/ liṅga bsdu snod/ lcags slang / spos phor/ spos rengs/ gu gul sogs spos sna tshogs/ thun gtor dang lhag mar 'dzugs rgyu'i dpal 'bar/ sgrub khang gi steng du spyan 'dren gyi ba dan lnga/ zhal lhor bstan gyi dbang du byas nas/ nub tu g.yung mo/ shar du gtum mo/ lhor srin mo/ byang du siṅga lī rnams bkod/ snga dro dkar cha bzhi mdzad na de'i chas sogs bsham mo// //zhes pa'i bshams yig 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ nag po chen po tsaturmukha'i bskang chog sngon 'gro bsham yig zur bskol/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
